Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite sheet, transparent RGBA, 2048x2048 square with exactly FOUR isolated complete full-body figures in a spacious 2x2 grid, no words or panels. Reference image is Utsu's identity and painterly anime rendering, brown tousled hair, young adult male, navy torn cloak gold star clasp, cream tunic, leather belts, silver left shoulder armor and greaves, dark gloves. Preserve adult proportions, leg lengths, costume and face. Camera fixed three-quarter side view, enemy always SCREEN RIGHT. No background, shadows, FX, streaks, ghost bodies. EACH cell must fit both boots AND the entire TWO swords with generous separation.
REDESIGN WEAPONS: two matching substantial one-handed LONG arming swords, straight silver double-edge blades with central ridge, gold crossguards, dark grips. Each blade guard-to-tip length equals about THREE AND A HALF head heights, width approximately a quarter head height, broad parallel middle and taper only final quarter. NEVER daggers. Consistent swords and character scale in all four cells. Full sword silhouette must be readable.
This sheet is frames 1-4 of ONE weighty forward step, sequential top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right:
1 READY: body upright, knees soft, front foot screen right, front sword rising diagonally to upper right, rear sword low pointing behind left. Existing reference stance with longer swords.
2 LOAD: rear knee flexed, pelvis shifts back, torso winds away from target, right-hand sword draws back at hip, left blade guards forward; keep body adult length, no shrinking.
3 PUSH: rear leg extends forcefully, pelvis advances screen right, front leg reaches ahead heel first, chest still wound back, blades lag behind pelvis, cloak trailing left.
4 PLANT/COIL: front foot planted far screen right, rear heel raised, pelvis starts turning toward right but shoulders remain wound, right sword far behind torso at left horizontal ready to sweep, left sword angled down/back at left at different height. Strong broad stance, both blades fully visible separated. It must visibly store rotation for a broad right-hand horizontal slash.
Draw true changed anatomy for all four stages, coherent force path from feet through pelvis, not four copies with hands changed.

Production transparent RGBA sprite sheet, exactly FOUR isolated full-body animation cels in spacious 2x2 grid. Reference 1 defines Utsu's identity, costume and existing painterly anime linework. Reference 2 is the redesigned long broad silver dual swords and initial footwork. Keep same adult proportions, face, hair, navy torn cloak, cream tunic, silver armor ONLY on anatomical left shoulder, belts, gloves, boots. Fixed camera three-quarter side, target SCREEN RIGHT. Every whole body and both sword tips entirely within its own cell, no text, no effects, no shadows, true transparent background. Each long sword blade about 3.5 head heights long, quarter head height wide, pronounced ridge and gold guard. Do not shrink blades or body to fit. Generous cell spacing.
Draw FOUR successive stages of FIRST RIGHT-HAND HORIZONTAL CLEAVE. Do not repeat a posing stance. Tell a forceful animation through extreme pelvis versus shoulder rotations:
TOP LEFT: DRIVE. Front leg planted screen right, rear foot pivots, pelvis already rotates right while shoulders lag facing viewer; right fist still FAR BEHIND at screen left, blade pointing behind left. Left hand tucked near ribs with left blade low/behind clear of right.
TOP RIGHT: ACCELERATION. Pelvis and chest rotate, right shoulder comes forward, right elbow opening, right sword sweeps across in front of chest at an oblique angle, full long blade clear in silhouette. Left hand actively draws back to hip to charge second hit. Both feet grounded broad stance.
BOTTOM LEFT: CONTACT. A forceful wide right horizontal cleave through target at screen right. Right arm fully reaches outward to screen right, long blade angled slightly toward lower right fully visible, torso turns almost showing BACK as right shoulder drives across. Front knee bent supporting mass, rear heel lifted, left sword cocked behind screen left. No impact glow. Strongly twisted waist.
BOTTOM RIGHT: FOLLOW THROUGH / NEXT LOAD. Right sword has passed through target and descends toward front right, right shoulder follows through, pelvis sinks and left shoulder pulls back, LEFT sword drawn low behind screen left ready to sweep diagonally up. Clear counter-rotation, opposing arms, cloak trailing earlier direction. Not a return to neutral.
Do not create daggers, duplicate limbs, additional swords, face front in every cell, or symmetrical fencing poses.

Transparent production game sprite sheet. TWO complete full-body Utsu figures stacked VERTICALLY, top and bottom, with enormous horizontal space for longswords, portrait 1024x1536 or larger. Each figure occupies at most 40% image height. Leave a clear transparent gap between figures, and outer margin at least 60px. Reference 1 is identity and painterly anime costume; reference 2 weapon design and forceful rotations. Brown hair, cream tunic, navy ripped cloak, silver armor anatomical left shoulder, greaves, leather belts. Two matching long, substantial steel swords, straight broad parallel blades until last quarter, gold guards. Each blade length THREE head heights MINIMUM, same proportions both hands. Character adult 7.5 heads tall when standing, no big head/chibi.
TOP FIGURE: RIGHT-HAND HORIZONTAL CLEAVE CONTACT toward screen RIGHT. Camera sees mostly his BACK and right side, head looks right at enemy. Right arm fully extended toward screen RIGHT at shoulder level, long sword projects right and slightly down. Left hand stretches back screen LEFT at waist, left sword extends long to left. Pelvis twists hard with weight on deeply bent front knee at screen right; rear left leg extends back, heel raised. Cloak trails to left, chest follows sword. Both blade tips and boots completely visible.
BOTTOM FIGURE: FOLLOW THROUGH of same right cleave. Right arm and sword continue down in front of planted right-side foot, tip near ground at far right but not cropped. Chest rotated forward, shoulders inclined, left shoulder pulling back and LEFT sword low far behind to screen left, preparing diagonal rising cut. Rear leg starts pushing body upright. Both arms apart, left sword is very clearly a long blade, not a dagger.
Fixed three-quarter battlefield side camera, stable character scale between figures. Sharp clean detailed painted sprite edges. No FX, motion trails, text, shadows, background, opponent, extra limbs or swords. This sheet must be cleanly separable into TWO sprites with zero overlap and generous margin.

Use case stylized-concept. Transparent game animation sprite sheet with FOUR isolated FULL BODY Utsu figures in 2x2 grid. Image must have large transparent gutters separating cells; figures and long swords may occupy ONLY central 80% of each cell. No body/sword crosses cell boundaries. Reference is same Utsu identity costume and painted anime style. Adult male 7.5 heads tall, tousled brown hair, navy torn cloak, cream tunic, belts, gloves, silver greaves and LEFT shoulder armor. Keep two identical LONG straight broad steel arming swords with gold crossguards. Blade from guard to tip must be THREE times head height, long parallel edges taper only last quarter, same blade length in every pose. Small head, long adult limbs. Fixed three-quarter side camera, enemy SCREEN RIGHT.
This is second attack: LEFT-HAND rising diagonal slash. Arm on silver shoulder side is LEFT, active throughout. Right hand holds the other sword low and opposite. Sequential top-left then top-right then bottom-left then bottom-right.
1 LOW WINDUP: deep stance, front foot planted right, back knee bent; left shoulder drawn back, LEFT sword low trailing diagonally toward bottom LEFT; right sword already swept through and stays forward/right at waist. Torso and hips twisted, looks at screen right.
2 HIP DRIVE: legs extending, pelvis rises and rotates, left elbow drives forward/up while left sword still lags low to LEFT; sternum begins rotating to show more FRONT, right arm pulls back with sword to left at another height. Visible changing chest orientation.
3 RISING CONTACT: left shoulder drives forward, LEFT arm extends upward to screen right, long blade diagonal up-right fully visible; torso powerfully extended, front knee straightens, rear foot pushes. Right arm spread behind at low left, right sword points left. Dynamic asymmetry; no levitation.
4 RISING FOLLOW-THROUGH/PIVOT: left sword high above right shoulder, tip reaching upper-right, chest and pelvis turned, rear foot steps around front pivot, head looks right. Right sword pulled back at low waist to screen left ready for next rotational horizontal cut. This is force continuing through body, not neutral stance.
Four strongly distinct full-body drawings, exaggerated torso twist and weight transfer. No effects, no glowing blades, no text, no checkerboard, no shadows or backdrop. Entire feet and long blade tips visible.

Transparent animation sprite sheet of Utsu, FOUR full-body figures in spacious 2x2 grid. Same identity and detailed painterly anime costume as references: young adult brown-haired swordsman, navy torn cloak, cream tunic, silver LEFT shoulder armor, silver greaves, dark gloves leather belts. Small realistic head, long adult legs, maintain identical body proportions. Two matching long straight steel swords, each blade from guard to tip THREE head lengths, broad silver blade with central ridge, gold crossguard. Entire boots and swords must fit individually with blank transparent gutters, no overlapping sprites. No effects or backdrop or lettering. Enemy screen RIGHT, fixed three-quarter battlefield camera. Four consecutive stages of THIRD STRIKE, right-hand rotational horizontal slash flowing from a left rising slash.
TOP LEFT PIVOT: back facing camera three-quarter, head looks screen right; LEFT sword still raised upper-right, RIGHT sword pulled far back to left at waist. Rear foot crosses behind planted pivot foot; hips turn first.
TOP RIGHT UNWIND: torso turns from back view toward front, knees flex, right shoulder advances, right blade still lags at far left while right elbow leads; LEFT sword high trailing overhead. Both swords separated.
BOTTOM LEFT BROAD CONTACT: right arm extended fully toward screen right, right long blade horizontal right, body frontal/three-quarter with waist deeply twisted, front knee takes weight, left arm spread back with blade angled up-left. Very large silhouette reaching left and right, cloak swings behind rotation. Both feet contact ground.
BOTTOM RIGHT FOLLOW-THROUGH/SPRING: right sword sweeps lower-right beyond target, chest follows, knees gather slightly into compressed stance; left sword now cocked high above head to prepare jumping downward cut. Head continues looking right. Different body rotation from contact.
Clear active RIGHT hand vs armored LEFT shoulder; do not swap arms between frames. No duplicated hands, no short daggers. Wide horizontal sword travel with strong changed chest orientations.

Transparent RGBA sprite sheet, FOUR complete isolated Utsu full-body action cels, 2x2 grid, wide transparent gutters. Same character and painterly detailed anime art as reference: tousled brown hair, navy ragged cape gold star brooch, cream tunic leather belts, silver anatomical LEFT shoulder pauldron and greaves, dark gloves. Two matching LONG straight steel arming swords with gold crossguards, blade length 3 head heights, broad middle, taper only last quarter. Adult small head and long limbs, identical proportions across cells. Fixed three-quarter side camera, enemy always SCREEN RIGHT. Entire boots, head and both blade tips visible with generous margin. NO effects, NO motion streaks, NO text, NO background or ground shadow. Swords are NOT daggers.
Fourth attack: LEFT-HAND downward slash with small airborne step, followed by weighted landing. Active sword belongs to armored left shoulder side.
TOP LEFT LIFT: rising from planted rear foot, front knee rises toward right, chest twists back, LEFT sword high behind head, RIGHT sword extended down/back screen left; clear leg extension pushes body off ground.
TOP RIGHT FALLING ACCELERATION: airborne short hop with torso pitched forward, pelvis begins descending, LEFT elbow leads a powerful downward slash with long blade still raised diagonally up-right. Right sword held behind left, legs prepare front-foot landing. Face screen right.
BOTTOM LEFT DOWNWARD CONTACT: deep front-foot landing on screen right, front knee flexes to absorb mass, rear leg stretched left, torso follows LEFT sword cutting steep diagonal down-right through target, long sword visibly extended beyond hand. Right sword drawn back/up-left for balance. Body not tiny or curled.
BOTTOM RIGHT ABSORB / FIFTH LOAD: both feet planted in broad stance, hips sink low, shoulders square partially toward viewer, both elbows draw swords up/out on opposite sides for final crossing cut, one sword upper-left one upper-right, V shaped preparation. Weight has visibly settled into legs, not floating.
Four different poses, clear whole body mass, no decorative acrobatics disconnected from sword.

Use case stylized-concept. FOUR isolated full-body Utsu cels on transparent RGBA, 2x2 sprite sheet, clean generous transparent gutters. No background, gradients, shadows, effects, glowing trails, labels. Reference 1 identity, reference 2 updated sword dimensions and body style. Brown-haired adult swordsman, navy torn cape with star brooch, cream tunic, leather belts, silver LEFT shoulder pauldron and greaves, dark gloves. Long adult limbs and small head. Same character scale. TWO matching substantial LONG steel arming swords, gold crossguards, blade length THREE head heights, width quarter head height, straight edges broad through middle and taper last quarter. Entire swords and feet fit inside EACH cell without touching edges or other cels.
Fixed three-quarter side camera, enemy screen RIGHT. Fifth and final heavy DUAL CROSSING CLEAVE, not a thrust.
TOP LEFT CROSS ACCELERATION: wide planted stance front knee to right, hips drive forward, shoulders roll forward with both swords coming from high spread V toward crossing ahead of chest. Elbows leading and blades still high diagonally, torso leans toward target, cape lags behind left.
TOP RIGHT CROSS CONTACT: powerful deep forward lunge to right, both hands ahead of sternum, two long blades intersect in a LARGE X in front to screen right, tips fully visible beyond both sides of X, do not merge blades. Chest drives through, rear leg pushes, front knee flexes. This is clearly simultaneous crossing slash with TWO distinct swords, one in each hand.
BOTTOM LEFT FINAL FOLLOW THROUGH: blades have passed each other and spread DOWN and OUT on opposite sides of body, left and right arms open, low pelvis, front planted knee braced, rear leg extended back, torso follows forward, head looks right. Long blades to down-left and down-right, broad dramatic silhouette.
BOTTOM RIGHT RECOVERY: feet gather moderately while still planted, torso rises, swords lowered outward left/right with full blades visible, breathing balanced stance facing screen right. Not smiling, tired determined expression. Long swords consistent with other frames.
Detailed coherent anatomy, sequential weight transfer, sharp painted edges. Exactly two swords per figure.
